logic_errors: P2 — docs/design/supplemental.html:118,141,152: Hide text now silently discards unsaved settings. In Settings → Privacy, select 7 days without applying, then activate either masking control. maskToggle() calls render(), which calls renderSettings(); that rebuilds the retention selector from the committed 30-day value and unconditionally clears settingsDirty, without Apply, Cancel or discard confirmation. Notification/workspace drafts are affected by the same path. This contradicts the explicit Apply/Cancel and unsaved-edit contract in docs/design/UX-CONTRACT.md:104. Independently reproduced by executing the actual inline mask/render functions with DOM-boundary stubs: dirtyAfter=false, persistedRetention=30, rerendered30Selected=true, rerendered7Selected=false, discardConfirmationCalls=0. This is a prototype interaction defect, not a production privacy leak. Preserve pending form values and dirty state across presentation-only masking.
suggestions: Add a regression exercising the actual inline UI masking/render path with an unapplied retention, notification or workspace edit. The existing model-only settings and masking tests do not cover draft preservation.
